name: Talent Matchmaker
description: Reads through your inbox — investor updates, inbound mail — for two kinds of signal: companies with vacancies and people quietly looking, then keeps a running picture of both sides. Useful if hiring chatter genuinely passes through your email; useless if your deal flow lives elsewhere.
